finding.summary: PR #1536 blocks a CORROBORATED result with zero independent sources, but its proposed validator still trusts caller-supplied independence_group values and does not bind declared source IDs to specific evidence records for the same claim. The existing SourceIndependenceEngine was also not used by the MMI validator.

observed_gaps.behavior: _independence_groups_for accepted the free-form SourceRecord.independence_group field without deriving or checking it against the source URI.
observed_gaps.consequence: Two records from the same publisher could be assigned different group strings and pass the two-group check.

observed_gaps.behavior: CORROBORATED validation checked independent_source_ids against the source graph but did not require those source IDs to appear in named EvidenceRecord objects supporting the same claim.
observed_gaps.consequence: Unrelated external source records could be named in the corroboration result while the actual evidence records referred to different sources.

observed_gaps.behavior: CONTRADICTORY validation checked non-empty evidence-ID strings and reconciliation references but did not require the IDs to resolve to actual evidence records with matching claim identity and support polarity.
observed_gaps.consequence: A contradiction could be marked reconciled using placeholder or unrelated evidence identifiers.

observed_gaps.behavior: The existing engine grouped by raw URL netloc, so ports and subdomains could split one publisher into multiple identities. It was not connected to MMI validation.
observed_gaps.consequence: False independence could be counted across subdomains or alternate ports.

changes: Resolve publisher identity from validated HTTP(S) URI hostnames, normalize IDNA, ports, www and common multi-label public suffixes.
Collapse known SBI Holdings, SBI Shinsei Bank, SBI VC Trade and SBI Ripple Asia domains into one SBI publisher group while keeping Tokyo SBIC separate.
Require each declared independence_group to equal the URI-derived canonical publisher identity.
Add claim_id to EvidenceRecord and require CORROBORATED results to identify at least two existing supporting evidence records for the same claim.
Require the corroboration source-ID set to equal the exact union of source IDs attached to those supporting evidence records.
Require corroborating evidence to be OBSERVED or PARSED, not inferred or hypothesized.

Require CONTRADICTORY results to reference existing supporting and contradicting evidence records with the same claim_id, correct support polarity, independently sourced evidence, and explicit reconciliation of both sides.
Make the MMI adapter derive publisher identity from the source URI and reject caller-supplied mismatches.
Preserve the existing append-only MMI execution ledger.

tests_added_or_updated: Normalize www, subdomains, ports and country-code public suffixes to one publisher identity.
Collapse known SBI corporate domains while keeping Tokyo SBIC separate.
Reject non-HTTP(S) source URIs as external publisher identities.
Reject forged independence_group values that conflict with URI-derived identity.
Reject source IDs not linked to the named claim's evidence records.
Reject evidence records with mismatched claim IDs.
Reject HYPOTHESIZED evidence from counting as observed corroboration.
Preserve contradictory evidence only when both existing sides are reconciled.
residual_limitations: Canonical publisher identity is a domain-level heuristic, not proof of independent reporting lineage. Syndicated or derivative articles from different publishers can still share one upstream source.
A future lineage_id/origin_source_id is needed to collapse republished material and multiple reports derived from the same press release or dataset.
The publisher alias registry is intentionally small and requires reviewed maintenance as source coverage expands.
GitHub code search surfaced the MMI adapter definition but no verified application-level production instantiation; end-to-end live ingestion integration remains unverified.
This branch is stacked on PR #1536 and must not be merged before its parent is merged and verified.
next_actions: Create a draft follow-up PR targeting the parent PR #1536 branch.
Run exact-head CI and fail-closed verification.
Inspect all application-level MMI adapter call sites before claiming live ingestion integration.
Add source lineage/origin IDs to distinguish genuinely independent reporting from syndicated or common-origin material.
Keep forecast issuance blocked until independent evaluation attestation is implemented and verified.
